page.layout: One printed page: main text in one column, centred page number above it; a narrow column of text in the right margin belonging to the facing page (cut off at the edge, partly visible). Text column is the main block; the right-edge strip is a neighbouring page fragment.

main_text.p: concipiamus in medio terræ Oceanum quasi ignis purissimi latè extensum æ-stuare, ex quo, si non flumina, saltem rivuli &c, ad minimum effluvia continua per omnes terræ partes, (uti sanguis & spiritus, ex corde per omnia nostra membra) indefinenter distribuuntur, illasque calefaciunt, fovent & vegetant, sic ut ubique in terra inveniat aptissimum instrumentum, quo in infinitum hic mille artifex opera sua variare potest. Hinc & Deus, Princeps & Dominus hujus mundi, vel ævi, id est, hujus terræ hoc nomine dici potest, qui sibi (quamvis impudentissimè) omnia regna mundi ejusque thesauros adscribit, & potens est in filiis inobedientiæ vel hujus mundi per hæc opera sua, quibus eos ludit & illudit.
main_text.head: III.
main_text.p: Imò si rem penitius introspiciamus, quid absurdi sequeretur, si dicamus damnatum hunc Genium, non tantùm sic igni huic jungi, ut per eum operetur, uti mens nostra per spiritus animales, sed etiam per ignem hunc, ipsi omnibusque damnatis à principio mundi jam paratum, pati, sicuti mens nostra etiam ultimò & immediatè per spiritus animales patitur; quippe in utroque mentium finitarum conjunctio
Note: the signature-like catchword "ctio" appears at the foot right.

page.notes: Right margin fragment shows cut-off text of the facing page (e.g. "stio juxt", "fion", "one", "tell", "stis"), not transcribed in full because it is cropped and illegible. Catchword "ctio" at the foot of the text column. Right-hand edge belongs to the facing page; its partial words are not reliably readable.
